posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are STILL the only 5-0 team in Busters Anonymous with a league-best 788.44 points, and twenty-two editions in, triciagloston's 'quiet dominance' needs a new nickname because there's nothing quiet about burying the field by this much.
posts.detail: A 1-season sample with a 6-7-1 career mark is irrelevant noise at this point — the 2026 tape says undisputed best team in the league, full stop.

posts.headline: Thicks is 4-1 and clinging to first in the Booty Warriors, but thirty editions of me pointing at that 14-14 career record and 5.5 average finish means the 2025 ring is officially on thin ice heading into the back half.
posts.detail: A reigning champion's manager should be running away with his division, not sweating a 624.6 points-for total that's the lowest of any 4-1 team in the league.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner hits the THIRTIETH edition of this column still stuck at 1-4, and a franchise sporting a league-best 1.5 average finish and 20-8 career record has now officially become the longest-running fraud investigation in Busters Anonymous history.
posts.detail: Put it in Ra's pedigree says perennial title favorite; the 596.4 points-for and five straight weeks of misery say something closer to a cautionary tale.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way drops to 1-4 with a league-worst 490.18 points, and Pharaoh23's bottom-feeder résumé — a 10 average finish locked in from season one — just keeps writing itself right on schedule.
posts.detail: Nothing about this roster suggests a turnaround is coming; the points-for gap between this team and everyone else is now a full chasm.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT falls to 0-5 and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin is now delivering a drought of truly Old Testament proportions — locusts, frogs, and a winless record all in the same plague cycle.
posts.detail: The man who drafted a defensive player first overall is reaping a 0-5 harvest, and a 13-14-1 career record says this isn't a fluke, it's a pattern of biblical self-sabotage.
